topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Well, now, I heard about your friend and what they been sayin' 'bout their job. T'is a tricky business, this lying. I always found the truth grows best in honest soil, just like my cabbages and turnips. A fib now and then, maybe that's one thing, but when it's a master at it, well, that's a whole other bean stalk. I reckon you've done right by confrontin' them. It shows you value the seed of true friendship. Can't blame a man for wantin' a solid harvest of good company, eh?
